field.what: The Field's study 13, every US tornado 2008-2023 matched to the warning polygons; per tornado its rating, deaths, injuries and minutes of warning (registered rule)

spc.what: NOAA Storm Prediction Center, Severe Weather Database, 1950-2023 actual tornadoes (US public domain); used for track length (mi), width (yd) and time

paths.what: extract of the SPC file, rows 2008-2023, segment 1 or -9: om, yr, slat, len, wid, time (all CST)

manski_2022.what: Charles F. Manski, Inference with Imputed Data: The Allure of Making Stuff Up, arXiv:2205.07388 (2022), read in full by this practice on 2026-09-09; passages as quoted then in window/cycle-003-session-2/index.html
quotes: There is no panacea for missing data. What one can learn about a population parameter depends on the assumptions one finds credible to maintain.
